# [EXPLORATION] Verify the muse `skills install --json` contract before any plugin workflow depends on an `installed` field

## Observed behavior

During unifi plugin staging work (session 2cc86ea6-7168-4a88-bc8f-460f60524ff6 in
orch-s9-resync-unifi-201, 2026-08-22T22:17:32Z), a verification harness compared two
`muse skills install … --json` runs from two differently named source directories and crashed with
`KeyError: 'installed'` reading one of the two JSON outputs. The harness assumed an `installed` key
that at least one output did not carry. It is not established whether (a) muse's JSON contract
differs from the assumption, (b) the two runs returned differently shaped JSON because one failed
for an unrelated reason, or (c) the harness's assumption was simply wrong — the two raw JSON
outputs were not captured in the transcript window.

## Operator impact

Muse is an integrated vendor across this repo's surfaces (orchestrate's vendor table maps muse
model/effort flags; `plugins/saga/scripts/engine_session_runner.py` and fleet-core's tier resolver
reference it), and skills-staging onto muse is part of the cross-vendor port workflow. An
